verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key and HSM product line covering FIDO2, OTP, OpenPGP and PIV. Autonomous background automations are a category error for a hardware authentication token, and nothing in the evidence shows Nitrokey ships such a capability. The nitropy CLI and Python SDK are device-management tools that could at most serve as building blocks, not a product automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
